spots-2026-03-27.jsonl.query:
SELECT id,time,rx_sign,rx_loc,tx_sign,tx_loc,frequency,power,snr,code FROM wspr.rx
WHERE band=7 AND code=1 AND time>='2026-03-27' AND time<'2026-03-28'
AND cityHash64(tx_sign,rx_sign,toString(toDate(time,'UTC')))%48=0
ORDER BY time,id LIMIT 250001 FORMAT JSONEachRow

noise-2026-03-27.jsonl.query:
SELECT toStartOfHour(time) AS h, site,receiver,substring(upper(rx_loc),1,4) AS grid,
medianExact(rms_level) AS noise,count() AS n FROM wspr.wsprdaemon_noise
WHERE band='40' AND time>='2026-03-20' AND time<'2026-03-28' AND rms_level BETWEEN -165 AND -70
AND (ov=0 OR ov IS NULL) GROUP BY h,site,receiver,grid ORDER BY h,site,receiver,grid
LIMIT 250001 FORMAT JSONEachRow
